zechariah.2.p1.b1.text: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.

zechariah.2.p1.b3.text: To measure Jerusalem … and to determine its width and length.

zechariah.2.p1.b4.text: Run and tell that young man … Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of men and livestock within it.

zechariah.2.p1.b5.text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”

zechariah.2.p2.b1.text: Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north … for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven

zechariah.2.p2.b2.text: “Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!”

zechariah.2.p2.b3.text: whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye

zechariah.2.p2.b4.text: Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you

zechariah.2.p2.b5.text: On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and they will become My people.

zechariah.2.p2.b6.text: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.

zechariah.2.p2.b7.text: Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
